title: Arrow presets and saved custom styles
summary: Reuse original arrow presets or save your own color, opacity and width settings locally.

Added: Eight original arrow presets in a four-column gallery, plus up to24 saved custom styles with names, RGBA color and width.
Save, refresh and right-click removal with local restart persistence; CLI style commands use the same storage and document engine.
Protected: Applying a style preserves endpoints and other objects, supports one-step Undo/Redo, and skips unchanged reapplications. Removing a preset leaves document history intact.
Atomic bounded storage protects against corrupt files, concurrent updates and invalid styles.
Fixed: Translucent arrows now composite over the background once per covered pixel, including overlapping shaft/head segments.
Verified: 100 regular Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy; native save/draw/restart/apply/remove and256000 exact clipboard pixels.
Independent source-over pixel colors and256000 CLI pixels, unchanged geometry and corruption/validation handling.

limitations: Thick diagonal arrow strokes still show seams; continuous stroke coverage is the next rendering milestone. Alternative and filled arrowheads remain planned.
Themes, favorites, other tool families and exact reference post-draw selection behavior remain unfinished.
Custom styles are stored locally. Preset removal does not change existing arrows or projects.
